sources.entry: Dozer - Hide MacOS menubar items. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon] ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]](https://github.com/Mortennn/Dozer)

summary.one_liner: Dozer is a macOS menu bar utility that hides and shows menu bar icons to keep the bar looking cleaner.
summary.what_it_does: Dozer adds a few of its own icons to the macOS menu bar and uses them as anchors for hiding other menu bar items. Left-clicking a Dozer icon toggles visibility of the first group of icons, which are the ones positioned to the left of the second Dozer icon. Option-clicking shows an optional second group, positioned left of a third Dozer icon. Right-clicking a Dozer icon opens settings. Users reposition icons by holding command and dragging. The README says it is installed via Homebrew Cask or by dragging the app into Applications, and requires macOS 10.13 or later.
use_cases: hide menu bar icons on a Mac
toggle hidden menu bar apps on demand
keep rarely used status icons out of sight
install menu bar hider with Homebrew
how_to_run: Or download the app, open it, and drag it to the Applications folder
Hold command (⌘) and drag menu bar icons to position them relative to the Dozer icons
Left-click a Dozer icon to hide/show the first group of icons
Option-left-click a Dozer icon to show the optional second group
Right-click a Dozer icon to open settings
notable: Hides menu bar icons using positioned anchor icons rather than a separate panel
Optional second hidden group revealed with option-click
Settings opened by right-clicking a Dozer icon
caveats: Icons must be manually positioned relative to Dozer icons to be hidden
README does not describe license or paid tiers
